systemMessage: COMPACTION GUIDANCE: Do NOT include skill listings, slash command descriptions, or MCP tool listings in the compact summary. These are always available from the live system context and reinjecting them wastes tokens. Preserve only: (1) decisions and conclusions reached, (2) code or files created/modified and their purpose, (3) errors encountered and their resolutions, (4) current state of in-progress work, (5) specific skills actually invoked and what they produced, only if relevant to ongoing work.
